JquanUI Enterprise CRUD Demo

Standard business page pattern with CRUD, table, form validation, upload, pagination, state, and permissions.

SPA Shell

Router, stable shell, keep-alive views, tabs, breadcrumb, and permission-aware navigation.

Customer Management

A combined example for `crud + table + modal + formValidator + upload + store`.

Upload Center

Drag, paste, preview, manual upload, retry, and chunk upload hooks.

Schema Form Modal

`modal.form.schema` is now wired to `formValidator` automatically.
Fields using `required`, `min`, `max`, `pattern`, `matchField`, or `rules` in schema will generate validation rules automatically.

Runtime State

This page uses `store` for demo stats and `permission` for action visibility.
